en: Dependent on a wholesome state associated with the root, there arises a state not associated with the root and not wholesome by way of the root-condition. Under the root [condition], one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance, one.

Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with the root, there arises a state not associated with the root and not unwholesome by way of the root-condition. ... Under the root, three; under predominance, one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance, three.

Conditioned by a state that is dissociated from root and indeterminate, there arises a state that is dissociated from root but not indeterminate, by way of root-condition. [Under] root: one; object: three; predominance: one ... pe ... non-disappearance: three.
